establishments.name: BMC Headquarters Annexe Canteen
establishments.note: A historical closure and a subsequent reopening are both reported. The positive label concerns the documented reinspection, not a permanent certification.

events.title: Licence suspension revoked; canteen reopened
events.description: Hindustan Times reported that Maharashtra FDA revoked the suspension after substantial rectification of identified deficiencies. Indian Express later reported a 94% compliance result on reinspection.

events.title: Closed following FDA action
events.description: The canteen was closed following reported hygiene and food-safety non-compliances.

establishments.name: MMRDA Headquarters Canteen
establishments.note: Reports indicate operations were permitted to resume after the operator obtained the required licence. A reopening does not independently establish a satisfactory hygiene inspection.

events.title: Permitted to reopen after obtaining food licence
events.description: Indian Express reported FDA permission for resumption of operations after the operator obtained the necessary FSSAI licence.

events.title: Ordered to stop operations
events.description: An FDA inspection reportedly found the contractor operating without the mandatory FSSAI licence.

establishments.name: Suraj Lama Momos
establishments.note: A licence suspension was reported in October 2026. The current legal status has not been independently verified. Historical action is shown rather than claiming a current suspension.

events.title: Licence suspension reported
events.description: Indian Express reported that the establishment was among eateries whose food licences were suspended by Maharashtra FDA. Subsequent restoration status has not been verified.
